provenance: VF synthetic_reference implementation parameterization of the SA design freeze (Issue #97 D1-D9). Tank capacities/areas are derived from the accepted X2 scenario; pipe/valve/tank-margin/pump/head/motor ratings and PI gains are explicit X3 parameters chosen by the PM inside the frozen design (D8). No site rating is verified.

time.note: global deterministic 1-second coordinator windows; the two PI loops scan once per tick

units.note: all mixed-unit arithmetic happens at the named boundaries (m3h_per_m3s, bar_pa)

tanks.note: Hmax = Vmax/A; the four level bands are physical alarm hints, the operative alarm limits differ from the physical capacity (D3)

edges.note: no rating may mean infinity: every water edge declares an explicit capacity no greater than the adjoining process capacity unless documented

line1_process_trunk.note: aggregate shared capacity of the LINE1 process chain

t108-transfer-pump.note: h0 35 m keeps the shut-off head above the 8 m static lift at the 50 % bias speed so the level PV has authority in both directions; 100 % delivers >= 51 m3/h which covers the 36 m3/h line-1 feed

dist-hsp.note: Hstatic 0 and k=0 keep the accepted flat 4 bar X2 pump curve (40.77 m); r = 0.0006 bar per (m3/h)^2 converted at the named boundary: 60 Pa/(m3/h)^2 * 3600^2 / 9810 = 79266.06 s^2/m^5

vf-shw-ctrl-f106-inlet-flow-pi.rationale: SP 0.008 m3/s = 28.8 m3/h is the LINE1 steady-state flow of the balanced nominal operating point (intake 33.75 m3/h at the accepted 75 % duty speed minus the 20 % LINE2 split of the 36 m3/h T100 withdrawal); bias 90 % (40.5 m3/h) sits above it so the loop trims in both directions

vf-shw-ctrl-t108-level-pi.rationale: 20 %/(m) with a 50 % bias; at a 0.5 m error the pump request is 60 % of the 60 m3/h rated transfer flow

deferred_loops.vf-shw-ctrl-dist-pressure-pi: explicitly DEFERRED (D1): DIST keeps the declared fixed 80 % synthetic command subject to trips and physical feasibility
deferred_loops.vf-shw-ctrl-raw-flow-pi: deferred to X4 (RAW/T100 C2 stays X4)

queue.note: one tick of in-transit inventory per edge; queued water is physical inventory counted once (no unbounded buffer)

unavailable: chem-dosing dosing pumps (reagent dosing energy not modelled)
sludge-t201 processing pump (duty-cycle abstraction; energy marked unavailable)
any gravity/regulated-feed abstraction without a declared pump
energy.note: unmodelled energy is unavailable, never fabricated (D6)

acceptance.note: settling horizon derived from the tank area and the available flow: 20 m2 x 0.05 m = 1 m3 at ~0.0021 m3/s of net trim is far below 900 s
